description: This file defines a React component called SettingsView, which renders a user interface for displaying and interacting with various settings. It handles different types of settings ('check' and 'select') and allows toggling checkboxes or selecting options from a dropdown. It is part of the UI layer related to configuration or preferences in the application.

methods.name: SettingsView
methods.description: React functional component that renders a list of settings based on the provided settings array.

methods.name: renderSetting
methods.description: Helper function to render individual setting based on its type ('check' or 'select').
